claims.exact_statement: Let c*=29/2+4/ln(2). If for every nonconstant finite-cube Boolean f and every inherited physical block Y of size at most two the branch-adapted Bellman residual E_2(f,Y) is nonpositive, then G(f)<=(33/2+4/ln(2))I(f) universally and H(f)<=(35+8/ln(2))I(f).
claims.first_unproved_line: E_2(f,Y)<=0 for every nonconstant Boolean f and every inherited block |Y|<=2.
